body:
maria: Heads-up — I opened a draft PR to roll providers forward and split the big module into smaller pieces: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1345
ashwin: thanks — quick q: are we planning a big lockfile regen or incremental? want to avoid a huge churn for services using older providers.
tara: leaning incremental. we can pin new modules to the same provider versions and then follow-up with a small regen in a controlled window.
maria: exact plan in PR description — two-stage: (1) split modules, keep current provider pins, add compatibility shim; (2) after smoke and canary, do lockfile regen + bump top-level providers.
sam: can we add a migration doc for secrets wiring? past splits broke the secrets map for k8s manifests.
maria: yes — I added a section in the PR: how to map old variable names to new module inputs, example snippet: ```hcl
module "db" {
  source = "./modules/database"
  db_password = var.db_pass // previously module.db.password
}
```
ashwin: also watch for provider aliasing changes. if we hoist providers we need alias: "legacy" on the older module to avoid duplicate provider instances.
tara: good call. add test plan: deploy to staging-nonprod, run terraform plan against each workspace, and run a `tfsec` quick check.
infra-bot: deploy-checker: triggered plan on staging-workspace — plan succeeded with 2 resource replacements, 0 destroy. (run id: cb7f2)
sam: what does the plan replace? any state move required?
infra-bot: plan snippet: ```diff
  # module.network.aws_subnet.example will be replaced
  - resource "aws_subnet" "example" {}
  + resource "aws_subnet" "example" {}
```
maria: looks like a provider alias issue causing resources to reattach. I pushed a fix to the draft to wire alias = aws.legacy for the hoisted provider.
ashwin: thumbs up. once we merge stage-1, can we schedule a low-traffic window for lockfile regen? would prefer during US early morning.
tara: agreed. also add a rollback plan: restore previous module refs + restore state snapshot. note ops will need to coordinate DB maintenance windows if any infra downtime.
maria: I updated the PR checklist with rollback steps and a link to the state snapshot runbook.
sam: I'll review the PR today and add comments on secrets mapping. if all good, let's canary in staging-beta tomorrow morning. :eyes:
maria: thanks — ping me on the PR for any blocking comments. :thumbsup:
